D1A SOURCE-TO-STORY SEAM. Rewritten 2026-09-17 (single-developer mode) after an audit against main 0df1d9e7: NOT STARTED; the substrate exists; the path list below is still accurate. Original fleet gate text replaced by the SD gate at the end.

Standing: C1 landed (core/source.scala EvidenceSupport :1195, NarrativeSourceAtlas core/atlas.scala :712, SurfaceAtlasConformance :757) with ZERO production consumers outside core. D0 closed as superseded; its EvidenceSupport-emission item lives here. This slice migrates only acquisition, compiler and story source support; it does not touch align or codecs.

Exact paths (all exist; all still hold SpanSet / SurfaceAtlas / SourceSupport(score, spans)):
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/proposal.scala (EvidenceRef.spans: Option[SpanSet] :46-59)
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/resolve.scala (SourceSupport :254, EvidenceBundle.sourceSupport :288)
- acquire/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/task.scala (validateAgainst(atlas: SurfaceAtlas) :78)
- acquire/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/acquire/{ProposalSuite,ResolveSuite,TaskSuite}.scala
- document/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/document/compiler.scala: the four concrete atlas annotations named by ADR 0007 are now at :462 (NarrativeCompilerInput field), :485 (.of param), :932 (validateBundle), :996 (validateSpans)
- document/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/document/CompilerSuite.scala
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/model.scala (StoryModel holds source: StorySource + atlas: SurfaceAtlas, no bundle)
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/nodes.scala (support: SpanSet on Entity/Event/State/Situation/Segment nodes and ContextFrame)
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/alignment.scala (AlignmentSource.sourceSupport: Option[SpanSet] :44)
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/evidence.scala
- story/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/story/validate.scala (unconditional m.source.canonicalText :123)
- story/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/story/ValidatorSuite.scala
- story/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/probes/StoryModelUnforgeableSuite.scala

Required result: acquisition proposals and SourceSupport carry typed EvidenceSupport; NarrativeCompilerInput consumes checked NarrativeSourceAtlas while preserving exact SurfaceAtlas text construction; the four atlas annotations migrate without stage-order change; StoryModel holds checked bundle plus atlas and retains explicit safe text access for text models; story nodes and AlignmentSource retain heterogeneous support and its primary projection without fabricating SpanSet or canonical text. Movie time is PlaybackInterval / PlaybackIntervalSet / RationalTimebase (core/source.scala :808, :857); there is no MovieInterval type and none should be added.

Courts: every current text fixture and span lookup is unchanged; film source has no callable text slicing without an admitted text stream; foreign bundle, axis, stream or anchor refuses; empty or mixed unsupported evidence refuses; compiler accepts partial proposals and preserves gaps; no default epistemic status or source projection; changing support cannot retain a foreign claim, model or build receipt; apply, copy, fromProduct and Mirror doors remain closed for joined records. A source with no canonical text compiles through the same deterministic stages and retains playback intervals.

Decisions this bead forces before it starts (docs/plans/2026-09-17-one-point-oh-handoff.md section 7): it rewrites StoryModel and AlignmentSource, two of the most central published types. Either 1.0 is declared text-only and this lands as 1.x with a stated deprecation path, or this lands before the 1.0 signature freeze. Sequence after the annotation-intake P0 ADR (bd-01M2R74KP00S1C5N5HGBDJS9HT), which may change what a NarrativeSourceAtlas bundle means. Public vocabulary changes need an ADR 0007 amendment (SD5).

Gate (SD2/SD6): sbt checkAll green on the merge result including acquire, document and story on JVM, JS and Native; text golden parity; film contract fixture; mutation witness per new guard; cold review in a separate pass by a fresh-context agent, never in the same breath as authoring. No aligner, codec, output, provider or decoder edit.
